approved: Greenhouse and Energy Minimum Standards Amendment (Administrative Changes) Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would change the law that sets energy efficiency standards for products sold in Australia.
It would adopt recommendations from a 2019 review to make the scheme more flexible and reduce paperwork for businesses.
The explanatory memorandum does not give a start date or list the specific amendments.
The bill would implement recommendations from the 2019 independent review of the Act.
It would improve regulator performance and reduce administrative burden.
It would add flexibility to the scheme and reduce impacts on the regulated community.
Businesses that supply or use regulated products and the regulator that administers the Act.
